Hope and healing for children with disabilities in the world’s poorest communities.
We care deeply that children with disabilities in the world’s poorest communities live healthier, happier, longer lives. Too many of these kids are sick, lonely, abused, dying. We believe each one is loved & valued by God. No child should be forgotten.
